title: A JSON Schema inclusion benchmark case
description: What is known about the two schemas next to this file: does a.json accept every instance valid under b.json? The labels hold for draft 2020-12 with format asserted and patterns read in the dialect of the Rust regex crate.

a_subsumes_b.description: Whether a.json accepts every instance valid under b.json; null when the corpus claims nothing.

b_subsumes_a.description: The same question in the other direction.

upstream.description: The file this case comes from, as a path inside the source repository that collection.json names; the test suite's cases add the case id after a '#'.
